ValidationRule.description: If Type='Group Waivers' or 'SBT' then users are not supposed to Close Caseif Approval Status = 'Pending'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordType.Name=="Service Request", ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed'),
OR(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Group Waivers'), ISPICKVAL(Type,'SBT')),
ISPICKVAL( Approval_Status__c,' ') )
/*AND ( RecordType.Name=="Service Request", OR(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Group Waivers'), ISPICKVAL(Type,'SBT')), ISPICKVAL( Approval_Status__c,'Pending' ),ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed'))*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please submit your Case for approval before closing your Case.
